Event.Name: Device firmware update available
Event.Label: The list of Indigo Phidget devices with available firmware updates changed

Field.Label: Copy into action text:
Field.Description: Indigo variable: Phidgets22_FirmwareUpdatesAvailable. Select and copy this complete reference into an email body or other action text field.

Event.Name: Phidget device detached
Event.Label: An Indigo Phidget device has been detached

Field.Label: Must remain detached (seconds):
Field.Description: Delays this trigger and cancels it if the device reattaches first. A cancelled detach also suppresses its matching attach event. Use 0 for immediate execution.

Event.Name: Phidget device attached
Event.Label: An Indigo Phidget device has been attached
